hero.title: An 8-Tower Masterplan Launch at Cityscape Global
hero.body: Erth Real Estate Development launched its 8-tower Riyadh masterplan at Cityscape Global with a Manzili 360 platform, offline failover and on-site sales training.

sidebar: Thee Erth · 8-tower mixed-use masterplan with Raffles Hotel & Residences, Sofitel serviced apartments, Grade-A offices and a luxury retail mall
Browser-based 360 web platform · Interactive 3D tours · In-person sales training · Cityscape Global launch support

challenge.title: Launching 8 Towers on a Fixed Exhibition Date
challenge.body: Erth needed a digital sales platform that could present the scale, views and finishes of an 8-tower masterplan to investors and off-plan buyers at Cityscape Global in Riyadh.

cards.title: A Fixed Opening-Day Deadline
cards.body: Delivery was tied to the opening morning of Cityscape Global, leaving no margin for schedule slippage or build errors.

cards.title: Overloaded Exhibition Wi-Fi
cards.body: Crowded convention halls overload event Wi-Fi, risking lag, dropped frames or crashes during VIP buyer meetings.

cards.title: Sales Teams Under Pressure
cards.body: Without hands-on training, sales teams under exhibition pressure fall back on paper brochures.

solution.title: One Connected Setup for Web, Showroom and Exhibition Floor
solution.body: Manzili combined browser-based 360 navigation, showroom hardware, local network failover and in-person sales coaching.

blocks.label: No Plugins
blocks.title: Browser-Based 360 Web Platform
blocks.body: A lightweight WebGL model of all 8 towers, podium streetscapes and unit-level view corridors, loading in under 3 seconds on buyers' phones and sales iPads with nothing to download.

blocks.label: 3D Tours
blocks.title: Interactive 3D Environments
blocks.body: Walkthroughs of Raffles Residences, Sofitel apartments and Grade-A office floors let buyers check layouts, ceiling heights and finishes before they reserve.

blocks.label: Failover
blocks.title: Exhibition-Ready Failover Setup
blocks.body: Progressive loading and local edge caching kept presentations running independently of public exhibition Wi-Fi.

blocks.label: Sales Coaching
blocks.title: In-Person Sales Team Training
blocks.body: On-site coaching certified Erth's sales consultants on interactive presentations, answering layout and view questions, and digital reservations before the doors opened.

features.title: Digital Reservations
features.body: From interest to timed unit hold

stats.label: Uptime Across Cityscape Global
stats.title: No Event Downtime
stats.body: No downtime or frame-rate drops were recorded on touch tables or displays across the multi-day exhibition.

stats.label: Load Time
stats.title: Instant Access
stats.body: Under 3 seconds to load on showroom touch tables, sales iPads and buyer smartphones, even at peak hall traffic.

stats.label: Plugins or Downloads Needed
stats.title: Open on Any Device
stats.body: Buyers and consultants opened the platform in a standard browser, with no plugins or app installs.

stats.label: Towers Visualized
stats.title: Physical Scale Model Replaced
stats.body: One digital asset replaced costly physical scale models and is reused in permanent sales centers and web campaigns.

standards.title: Delivery Standards
rows: No third-party plugins and no firewall exceptions for buyers or IT teams
Architectural CAD and BIM geometry protected against unauthorized extraction
On-site engineers on the exhibition floor for the full event
